title: Make the ATM network's answers say what really happened

cases.says: a failure a participant reported is answered, as a reply to its request, with the network's code for that cause
a thrown exception, or a cause the network's table doesn't list, is answered 96, never with a decline
an approval already in RESPONSE is replaced when a later participant aborts the transaction
a partial approval (10) is an approval too, and is replaced on the abort path
a refusal a participant built itself is the answer and is not replaced, while a failure with nothing built gets one

origin.section: 10.3 On the Abort Path `SendResponse` Sends Whatever `RESPONSE` Holds
